{{Quote|Power up the guns; everyone take defensive positions.| [[Unidentified Naboo resistance fighter|The outpost commander]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />}}
A '''resistance outpost''' was a base for the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
The outpost consisted of several building protected by a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. On the outside of the shield, the outpost was protected by a number of [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]]. A mountain formed a natural barrier on one side.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" />

==History==
When the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] refers to its events taking place in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the invasion in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],</ref> the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were forced to defend their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] using any means necessary. The Security Forces used the outpost near the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]] to use as a base during the invasion.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" /> After the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] returned to the planet, she joined with the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|retake the planet]].<ref name="SWE1 novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> In response, the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] sent three strike forces to engage the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> [[Army B]] flanked the Great Grass Plains and [[Battle of the Naboo resistance base|found]] the outpost. A [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] warned the outpost, which activated its defenses. The Federation [[Heavy Artillery Gun]]s commenced attacking the turrets. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his wingmate [[Vana Sage]] joined the battle and engaged the attacking Federation forces, ultimately driving off the Federation army. The loss of this Federation element<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter" /> allowed the Gungans to hold out while the Security Forces destroyed the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], ending the invasion.<ref name="SWE1 novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
This outpost appeared in the penultimate mission, named "Last Stand on Naboo," of the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].
